ai_summary: Action Construction Equipment Limited (ACE) has notified stock exchanges of an upcoming analyst and investor institutional meet scheduled for November 17, 2026, as part of the Avendus Spark INDX Annual Investor Conference. This routine disclosure, made under SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, signifies the company's proactive engagement with the investment community through one-on-one and group meetings. There are no immediate red flags identified; this is a standard compliance update regarding investor relations activities.
